Move a concise Swing Net cue near the player while keeping movement help secondary. 3. Establish one illustration grammar across logo, landscape, player, net, and creatures—consistent outline weight, shadow softness, two/three-step shading, rounded geometry, and text spacing. Expressive creature silhouettes and the heavy player drawing currently fragment craft; vary anatomy and motion while enforcing one outline/shading system.
The sun supports atmosphere but competes with gameplay; lower only its local contrast rather than removing the scene's defining light.
rationale: I centered the one-round plan on making the core capture relationship instantly readable, then used controlled semantic variety to enrich the field without fragmenting its friendly system.
